Name: Abigail
Description: Abigail is a child originally from the Tristan Da Cunha off the British isles. Her powers suddenly manifested themselves in a factory, creating seismic waves, with devastating consequences. A team of New Mutants led by Magik and Warpath and made up of young Krakoa mutants; Kappa, Brutha Nature, Sprite, Leo, are sent to save the little girl, but arrived on the island they discover that the islanders and her mother were protecting the little girl, Warpath then decides to leave Abigail in the care of her family while the group continued to help with rescue and offer the child support if she needs it.
